jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Director, Pricing Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
At Varicent, We’re Not Just Transforming The Sales Performance Management (SPM) Market—we’re Redefining How Organizations Achieve Revenue Success. Our Cutting-edge SaaS Solutions Empower Revenue Leaders Globally To Design Smarter Go-to-market Strategies, Maximize Seller Performance, And Unlock Untapped Potential. Varicent Stands At The Forefront Of Innovation, Celebrated As a Market Leader In The 2025 Forrester Wave Report For SPM, 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index, Gartner Peer Insights, 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide, And G2. Our Solutions Are Trusted By a Diverse Range Of Global Industry Leaders Like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker And Hundreds More. Here’s Why You’ll Thrive At Varicent

Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.
Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.
Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.
Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

Summary Of The Role And Team

As Director of Deal Desk & Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote-to-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.
Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.
Own quote-to-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.
Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.
Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.
Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.
Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.
Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.

What You Bring

Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12+ years)
Experience leading teams, programs, or cross-functional operational functions (typically 5+ years)
Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell transactions
Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote-to-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design
Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms
Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions
Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations

Success Outcomes

First 90 Days

Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote-to-booking workflows.
Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.

Within 6 Months

Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.
Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.
Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.
Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.
Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.

Within 12 Months

Position Deal Desk as a go-to strategic partner across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.
Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.
Deliver scalable quote-to-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.
Build a high-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.
Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

This posting is for a existing
vacancy.

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making.

Overview Of Benefits

Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage tailored to your local needs
Time Off — PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most
Volunteer Days — Dedicated time to give back and support the communities that matter to you
Ignite Days — Dedicated learning days to support continuous growth, skill development, and professional learning
Financial — Compensation that reflects your market and your value
Retirement — Retirement plans designed to help you build long-term financial security
Tuition Assistance — Invest in your growth with support for continuing education and professional development
Flexibility — Work where you thrive, with remote and hybrid options available across most regions

Varicent is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process please email accomodations@varicent.com

Varicent is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. jobs.title: Senior Director of Data
jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store, and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

This position offers a base salary compensation range of C$215,000 to C$270,000 annually.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights, you are a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Brand Leadership team and to the Enterprise organization, shaping the future of the Arc’teryx brand through deep consumer understanding and insight-led strategy. You will define and lead the company’s Consumer Insights vision, ensuring the voice of the consumer is embedded at the core of brand and business strategy, decision making and long-term growth.  In this role you influence critical business and brand decisions through compelling storytelling and foresight, translating complex data into clear direction for senior leaders.

Acting as a catalyst for a consumer-first culture, you lead the growth of the company’s insights capabilities, operating models, and tools while building a high-performing global team. You also champion innovation in how the organization anticipates and responds to shifting consumer behaviors, ensuring the brand remains culturally relevant and positioned for sustained growth.

Ideally this role is based out of our North Vancouver office.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Brand team is the direct connection between the guest and the core intention of the Arc’teryx brand. Leveraging an increasingly robust set of consumer insights, we specialize in storytelling and creating incredible experiences that connect people to the transformative power of the mountains. Our functions include enterprise strategy, brand marketing and creative, athletes/ambassador's programs, community, experiences, operations, communications, regional teams, and agency partners. This team is comprised of global HQ and regional offices who aim to become the voice of the consumer within the organization.  You will work in close partnership with functional leaders across channels and regions to bring added value to the business during this high growth era.

You and your team will also support wider executive leadership, aggregating data from commercial, product and business partners to derive insights that inform the enterprise growth strategy.

If you were in the VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Setting the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for the global Consumer Insights function, strengthening brand equity, distinctiveness, and consumer connection while ensuring alignment to brand positioning, growth priorities, and long-term strategy

Serving as the enterprise leader and trusted advisor for consumer insights, embedding a consumer-first operating model and insight-led perspectives that shape executive decisions, strategic planning, and innovation across all functions, regions, and business units.

Building, leading, and developing a high-performing global Consumer Insights team, including organizational design, capability building, and succession planning

Translating complex, multi-source data into clear narratives and lead the evolution of advanced analytics, including predictive, prescriptive, and AI-driven approaches, next-gen measurement, and marketing effectiveness/ROI tools, to drive measurable business outcomes

Designing and scaling a global insights operating model and enterprise frameworks — tools, platforms, KPIs, and standardized methodologies — and build strategic external partnerships (agencies, data providers, industry experts) to democratize access and ensure best-in-class capability

Leading consumer segmentation and consolidate data and insights systems across the enterprise (with focus on product, channel, and regional data), anticipating emerging consumer behaviors and market dynamics to unlock acquisition, retention, and growth opportunities

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Shaping the future of brand-building through next-generation insights, leveraging AI, real-time consumer signals, and emerging technologies to create more adaptive, responsive, and culturally relevant brand strategies

Pioneering new approaches to understanding consumer connection and brand experience, evolving beyond traditional research to integrate behavioral, emotional, and cultural intelligence at scale

Future-proofing the Brand by embedding predictive foresight and scenario planning, enabling the organization to anticipate disruption, stay ahead of shifting consumer expectations, and unlock long-term brand growth opportunities

Are you our next VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights?

You have 15+ years of progressive experience across brand, consumer insights, and strategy functions, with a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, and proven capability building consumer insights strategies and frameworks

You have demonstrated success influencing executive leadership, translating insights into brand strategy, positioning, and global brand-building initiatives that drive equity and long-term growth

You have strong analytical and technical fluency, including advanced analytics, predictive modeling, AI-driven insights, and consumer data ingestion, integration, and governance across a multi-market environment

You have an exceptional ability to synthesize complex data into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive action

You are a proven people leader who sets clear vision, aligns global teams and cross-functional partners, and builds high-performing, diverse organizations within a complex matrix environment.

Your knowledge of technical apparel, outdoor, performance, or premium lifestyle categories, with in-depth understanding of the outdoor industry and the consumer culture Arc'teryx targets

You have a genuine passion for getting outside that matches your passion for the work

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is USD$224,000 - USD$336,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

Health & wellbeing
- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Financial wellbeing
- RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Time & Flexibilit
y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support
- Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).
  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better 
Disruptive evolution . In pursuit of better. Always. 
Commit.  We set bold objectives and see them through.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Director, AI Business Enablement

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a transformational leader who can serve as a strategic peer to senior business executives and drive AI-powered business transformation across an entire Line of Business or Function. As a Senior Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own the full AI transformation ambition for your domain — setting the vision, building the opportunity pipeline, and ensuring executive alignment from ideation through to program framing and handoff.

You will be expected to challenge, provoke, and co-develop transformation roadmaps with senior business leaders — bringing a combination of strategic rigour, AI fluency, and the credibility that comes from having built and shipped solutions, not just recommended them.

Your responsibilities will include:

Executive partnership: Holding sustained, peer-level strategic relationships with senior business leaders (SVP+); co-developing and communicating the AI-enabled transformation vision for your domain
Pipeline origination: Identifying, sizing, and prioritising a rigorous pipeline of AI transformation opportunities — including new ideas not yet on the business’ horizon — with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for large business problems and validating them through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Helping leaders fundamentally rethink business processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Partnering with business leaders beyond ideation — through business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing — to ensure ambition translates into execution
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our world-class AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between the transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise pattern recognition: Surfacing reuse opportunities, multi-LOB programs, and horizontal themes that no single vertical would initiate alone
Team leadership: Leading and developing a small team of high-performing leaders aligned to sub-segments within your domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 15+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of building AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by accountability for delivery outcomes
Possess the executive gravitas and communication skills to challenge and influence senior business leaders (SVP+) as a peer
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC
Shape the mandate and culture of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

new_jobs.description:
At Varicent, We’re Not Just Transforming The Sales Performance Management (SPM) Market—we’re Redefining How Organizations Achieve Revenue Success. Our Cutting-edge SaaS Solutions Empower Revenue Leaders Globally To Design Smarter Go-to-market Strategies, Maximize Seller Performance, And Unlock Untapped Potential. Varicent Stands At The Forefront Of Innovation, Celebrated As a Market Leader In The 2025 Forrester Wave Report For SPM, 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index, Gartner Peer Insights, 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide, And G2. Our Solutions Are Trusted By a Diverse Range Of Global Industry Leaders Like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker And Hundreds More. Here’s Why You’ll Thrive At Varicent

Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.
Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.
Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.
Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

Summary Of The Role And Team

As Director of Deal Desk & Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote-to-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.
Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.
Own quote-to-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.
Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.
Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.
Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.
Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.
Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.

What You Bring

Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12+ years)
Experience leading teams, programs, or cross-functional operational functions (typically 5+ years)
Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell transactions
Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote-to-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design
Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms
Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions
Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations

Success Outcomes

First 90 Days

Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote-to-booking workflows.
Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.

Within 6 Months

Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.
Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.
Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.
Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.
Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.

Within 12 Months

Position Deal Desk as a go-to strategic partner across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.
Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.
Deliver scalable quote-to-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.
Build a high-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.
Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director of Data
new_jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Director, AI Business Enablement

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a transformational leader who can serve as a strategic peer to senior business executives and drive AI-powered business transformation across an entire Line of Business or Function. As a Senior Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own the full AI transformation ambition for your domain — setting the vision, building the opportunity pipeline, and ensuring executive alignment from ideation through to program framing and handoff.

You will be expected to challenge, provoke, and co-develop transformation roadmaps with senior business leaders — bringing a combination of strategic rigour, AI fluency, and the credibility that comes from having built and shipped solutions, not just recommended them.

Your responsibilities will include:

Executive partnership: Holding sustained, peer-level strategic relationships with senior business leaders (SVP+); co-developing and communicating the AI-enabled transformation vision for your domain
Pipeline origination: Identifying, sizing, and prioritising a rigorous pipeline of AI transformation opportunities — including new ideas not yet on the business’ horizon — with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for large business problems and validating them through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Helping leaders fundamentally rethink business processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Partnering with business leaders beyond ideation — through business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing — to ensure ambition translates into execution
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our world-class AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between the transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise pattern recognition: Surfacing reuse opportunities, multi-LOB programs, and horizontal themes that no single vertical would initiate alone
Team leadership: Leading and developing a small team of high-performing leaders aligned to sub-segments within your domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 15+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of building AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by accountability for delivery outcomes
Possess the executive gravitas and communication skills to challenge and influence senior business leaders (SVP+) as a peer
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC
Shape the mandate and culture of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.
